shots.text: What turned a crash into a decade of misery

shots.text: was what happened next,

shots.text: and most of it happened

shots.text: inside people's heads.
shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — hard cut to extreme wide surreal composition — the neighborhood contracts into silhouettes inside a vast translucent human head, with fear-darkened thought clouds spreading from person to person; muted watercolor washes, flat shading, imperfect ink outlines

shots.text: Let's talk about banks, because this is the scariest part, and it's easy to understand.

shots.text: When you put money in a bank,

shots.text: the bank doesn't keep it in a big box with your name on it.

shots.text: It lends most of it out to other people,
shots.edit_instruction: BUSINESS PROCESS — cut to an overhead 16:9 view of the same coins dividing into many larger streams that leave the bank through separate doors while a small pile remains behind, muted watercolor washes and imperfect ink lines

shots.text: to build houses
shots.scene_description: BUSINESS PROCESS — dynamic low wide 16:9 view of carpenters raising the timber frame of a small house as a stream of loan coins transforms into lumber and roof beams, warm dusty daylight, hand-drawn 2D watercolor animation with muted washes, flat shading, imperfect thin ink outlines

shots.text: and run businesses,

shots.text: and keeps a smaller amount on hand for when customers want cash.

shots.text: That works perfectly
shots.edit_instruction: BUSINESS PROCESS — cut to a balanced symmetrical wide shot across the banking hall: deposits enter one side, loans leave the other, and routine withdrawals are paid from the center reserve, all flows moving smoothly

shots.text: as long as everyone doesn't show up on the same day.
shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — hard cut to a steep overhead view of a calendar-like grid without readable words: customers remain safely dispersed across many separate day squares while one crowded square darkens as a warning, muted watercolor style

shots.text: Now imagine you hear a rumor that your bank is in trouble.
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, average height, narrow build, shoulders subtly raised in habitual caution, rounded worried eyes, long straight nose, thin eyebrows, downturned mouth — wearing a dusty blue coat, cream shirt, and muted brown trousers — medium over-the-shoulder street view as a neighbor whispers beside the bank facade and a smoky dark thought shape reaches the customer's ear

shots.text: Maybe it's true.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, rounded worried eyes widening beneath thin eyebrows — hard cut to a close profile with the bank behind him; the rumor cloud briefly reveals a cracked vault and an empty drawer

shots.text: Maybe it isn't.

shots.text: and get your money out before everyone else does.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, tense mouth and widened eyes — cut to a customer-eye-level view pushing through the bank doors toward the distant cash counter while other figures begin entering behind him

shots.text: And what does everyone else do?

shots.text: The exact same thing.
shots.edit_instruction: GROUP — new high crane angle above the intersection as every pedestrian converges on the bank from multiple streets, individual paths becoming one dark watercolor current

shots.text: the bank runs out of cash,
shots.edit_instruction: OBJECT DETAIL — hard cut to an extreme close insert of the teller drawer as the last note is lifted away, leaving only bare wooden compartments and one trembling hand

shots.text: and it closes.
shots.edit_instruction: CONSEQUENCE — cut to a low exterior angle as heavy bank doors swing shut and chains lock across them, leaving the anxious queue reflected dimly in the glass; no readable signage

shots.text: The rumor came true because people believed it.
shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — wide pullback above the closed bank as the original dark rumor cloud circles through the crowd, transforms into withdrawal arrows, and returns as a solid crack through the building, muted watercolor feedback loop

shots.text: In 1948, the sociologist Robert Merton gave this a name.
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, tall slender frame, upright professorial posture, measured hand gestures, swept dark hair, observant narrow eyes, prominent nose, composed mouth — medium-wide 16:9 view of Merton at a 1948 lecture board, raising chalk toward an empty central space reserved for the concept

shots.text: He called it a self-fulfilling prophecy,
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, observant narrow eyes and composed mouth — cut to a close three-quarter angle as Merton completes centered board text reading "self-fulfilling prophecy" in Comic Sans MS, with nothing else written

shots.text: and the example he used to explain it was a bank run.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, prominent nose and intent narrow eyes — cut over Merton's shoulder to a chalk diagram beneath the retained phrase: a healthy bank, frightened queue, empty drawer, and closed doors connected in a loop, no additional words

shots.text: A perfectly healthy bank can be destroyed by fear alone.
shots.scene_description: ON-SCREEN IDEA — centered wide 16:9 composition of a solid, well-lit bank untouched by physical damage while translucent fear shadows from anonymous citizens squeeze inward until its walls buckle, hand-drawn 2D watercolor animation, muted cold washes, flat shading, imperfect ink outlines

shots.text: In the early 1930s, thousands of American banks failed.
shots.scene_description: CONSEQUENCE — vast 16:9 aerial view across an early-1930s American townscape as bank after bank darkens and closes in a spreading wave, queues and shuttered storefronts reduced to small silhouettes, hand-drawn 2D watercolor animation, desaturated sepia-gray washes, flat shading, imperfect ink outlines
shots.wardrobe_override: anonymous citizens in worn 1930s wool coats, faded dresses, patched trousers, and weathered hats

shots.text: And when a bank failed back then, there was no insurance.
shots.edit_instruction: OBJECT DETAIL — hard cut to a high-angle view inside one abandoned bank: empty cages, scattered passbooks, and a shattered transparent safety shield that fades away completely, no readable writing

shots.text: If your savings were in it,
shots.edit_instruction: OBJECT DETAIL — cut to a side-lit close insert of a household savings envelope trapped behind the locked bank grille while an anonymous hand reaches through but cannot touch it, muted sepia watercolor

shots.text: your savings were gone.
shots.edit_instruction: CONSEQUENCE — new frontal extreme close-up as the savings envelope breaks into pale watercolor pigment and washes out of the frame, leaving the reaching hand above bare stone

shots.text: Then the government made it worse.
shots.scene_description: ON-SCREEN IDEA — severe low-angle 16:9 view of monumental government buildings casting a longer shadow across rows of already fallen banks, the shadow pressing them deeper into the street, hand-drawn 2D watercolor animation, muted slate washes, flat shading, imperfect ink outlines

shots.text: The Federal Reserve, which is supposed to act like the grown-up in charge of the country's money,
shots.scene_description: ON-SCREEN IDEA — symmetrical wide 16:9 composition of a towering central-bank building imagined as an adult-sized guardian beside a fragile miniature economic town, one steadying hand hovering above streams of coins, hand-drawn 2D watercolor animation, muted blue-gray washes, flat shading, imperfect ink outlines

shots.text: mostly stood back while the banks fell.
shots.edit_instruction: CONSEQUENCE — cut to a distant lateral angle: the guardian building recedes behind closed gates while miniature banks topple sequentially across the foreground like heavy stone blocks

shots.text: The amount of money moving around the economy shrank
shots.edit_instruction: BUSINESS PROCESS — overhead map-like view of towns, farms, factories, and shops linked by broad flowing ribbons of coins; the ribbons narrow visibly and several routes fade, same muted watercolor world

shots.text: by about a third.
shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — hard cut to a frontal close graphic of three equal watercolor currents representing circulation; one entire current dries into cracked paper while two continue weakly, no numbers or words

shots.text: Decades later, in 2002,
shots.scene_description: full-bleed near-black watercolor background, no characters, centered on-screen text reading "Decades later, in 2002," in Comic Sans MS, nothing else written, still minimal 16:9 composition with faint paper grain

shots.text: a Federal Reserve official named Ben Bernanke said it plainly
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, medium height, stocky academic build, reserved posture behind lecterns, bald crown, short gray beard, rectangular eyes behind glasses, heavy brows — medium 16:9 view of Bernanke at a 2002 lectern, leaning toward the microphone with deliberate seriousness

shots.text: who had spent years studying this mistake.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, bright deep-set eyes behind square glasses — cut over Friedman's shoulder to layered memory images of research papers, contraction charts without readable labels, and rows of failed banks accumulating across decades

shots.text: Speaking about the Depression, he said, "
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, heavy brows lowered above rectangular eyes and a sober bearded mouth — new low three-quarter angle on Bernanke as the room falls still and he looks directly toward Friedman before quoting

shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, bald crown, short gray beard, heavy brows, serious rectangular eyes — cut to a tight frontal portrait as a restrained speech field beside Bernanke displays exact text "You're right, we did it. We're very sorry." in Comic Sans MS, nothing else written

shots.text: Now here's the trap that kept everyone stuck,
shots.scene_description: ON-SCREEN IDEA — top-down 16:9 view of a circular economic mechanism made from a shoe shop, factory, workers, households, and savings jars, each linked by arrows that form a closed trap, hand-drawn 2D watercolor animation, muted rust and slate washes, flat shading, imperfect ink outlines

shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — cut to a tilted close diagram where every individual arrow appears sensible and orderly, yet together they tighten the circular mechanism around the tiny neighborhood at its center

shots.text: Imagine you're scared.
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, average height, lean build, posture curling inward when uncertain, wide tired eyes, soft jawline, short dark hair, anxious pinched mouth — wearing a muted green jacket, tan shirt, and dark brown trousers — intimate medium shot at a small kitchen table, bills and a coin purse nearby, dusk pressing against the windows

shots.text: You might lose your job.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, wide tired eyes and anxious pinched mouth — cut to a close profile as a thought shadow shows the shopper's workplace door shutting and their own workbench fading into darkness

shots.text: So you stop buying new shoes
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, average height, lean build, posture curling inward when uncertain, wide tired eyes, soft jawline, short dark hair, anxious pinched mouth — wearing a charcoal raincoat, faded red scarf, and black trousers — wide 16:9 exterior of a shoe-store window as the shopper pauses before a new pair, checks worn shoes, then turns away

shots.text: and you save every penny.
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, average height, lean build, posture curling inward when uncertain, wide tired eyes, soft jawline, short dark hair, anxious pinched mouth — wearing a loose cream house shirt and soft blue-gray trousers — close overhead view at home as every coin from the worn purse drops into a plain savings jar
shots.wardrobe_override: loose cream house shirt and soft blue-gray trousers for a quiet evening at home

shots.text: That's smart.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, wide tired eyes settling and pinched mouth relaxing — cut to a medium side view as the shopper seals the jar and places it safely at the back of a cupboard

shots.text: For you.
shots.edit_instruction: ON-SCREEN IDEA — cut to a tight cupboard-level view: a soft protective glow surrounds only the shopper's jar while the room beyond falls darker, emphasizing the narrow boundary of the benefit

shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, short sturdy build, forward-leaning shopkeeper stance, restless hands, receding hair, heavy-lidded eyes, round cheeks, small worried mustache — wearing a rust cardigan, pale gray shirt, and dark apron — interior wide shot from behind untouched shoe displays as the owner watches the shopper disappear through the rainy window

shots.text: So he stops buying new stock from the shoe factory.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION, heavy-lidded eyes and worried mustache — cut to a high over-the-counter angle as the owner pushes an order form aside, closes the empty cash drawer, and leaves gaps on the stock shelves; no readable writing

shots.scene_description: CONSEQUENCE — broad 16:9 factory-gate view as several shoe workers carrying lunch tins and cloth gloves walk out while half the production windows go dark behind them, hand-drawn 2D watercolor animation, muted industrial blue-gray washes, flat shading, imperfect ink outlines

shots.text: Those workers stop buying things too.
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, broad shoulders, sturdy medium-height build, weary working stoop, square face, close-cropped hair, deep-set eyes, firm tired mouth — wearing a weathered ochre coat over a burgundy sweater with dark trousers — medium-wide market arcade view as the worker returns groceries to a stall and closes an almost empty coin purse

shots.text: And now more people are scared,

shots.text: so they save even harder.
shots.edit_instruction: CONSEQUENCE — new extreme-wide elevated angle over the neighborhood as many household hands pull coins indoors into separate jars, shop lights extinguish one by one, and the circular economic flow slows almost to a stop

shots.text: The economist John Maynard Keynes described something close to this.
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, tall lean build, upright formal posture, long oval face, neatly parted dark hair, narrow observant eyes, reserved mouth — John Maynard Keynes stands beside a chalk economy loop, medium-wide 16:9 composition, thoughtful lamplit study, wearing a deep navy suit, cream shirt, and muted burgundy tie

shots.text: It's sometimes called the paradox of thrift.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, long face and narrow observant eyes — hard cut to an over-the-shoulder view of the chalk loop collapsing inward around centered Comic Sans MS text reading "paradox of thrift"; nothing else is written

shots.text: When one family saves, it's wise.
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, two average-height parents and a small child with protective inward posture, rounded faces, soft tired eyes, restrained worried mouths — intimate 16:9 kitchen-table medium shot as the family drops coins into a clear savings jar, warm evening light, wearing faded teal, warm brown, cream, and dusty rose clothing

shots.text: When the whole country saves at once out of fear,
shots.scene_description: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES — elevated extreme-wide 16:9 view across many city apartments as hundreds of hands pull coins indoors and seal separate jars, windows dimming beneath a cold grey wash

shots.text: nobody buys anything,
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES — hard cut to street-level wide view of an empty commercial avenue; untouched goods fill windows while the last shopper turns away

shots.text: businesses close,
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES — low oblique angle along the same avenue as metal shutters descend sequentially and interior lights extinguish

shots.text: and everybody ends up poorer, including the savers.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES, rounded faces and soft tired eyes — cut inside the family kitchen from a high corner angle; the savings jar remains, but the table is nearly bare and unpaid envelopes surround it

shots.text: Every single person did the sensible thing,

shots.text: and together they made a disaster.
shots.edit_instruction: HAND-DRAWN 2D WATERCOLOR ANIMATION WITH MUTED WASHES, FLAT SHADING, AND IMPERFECT THIN INK OUTLINES — extreme-wide pullback reveals those isolated rectangles forming a dark city grid of closed shops, idle factories, and breadlines

shots.text: Prices dropped.
